name: How much does it cost to build a rooftop deck?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a rooftop deck?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building a rooftop deck varies significantly based on factors such as size, materials chosen, existing roof structure, access to the site, and complexity of the design. Expect costs to range depending on whether you opt for basic pressure-treated lumber or premium composite decking with custom features like built-in seating or pergolas. Additional expenses may include structural reinforcement, drainage systems, and specialized waterproofing. To get an accurate estimate, it's crucial to have a professional assessment of your specific property and design preferences. Hometelligent Inc. provides detailed proposals after an initial consultation to outline potential costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Rooftop deck costs vary based on size, materials, existing roof structure, and design complexity. A professional assessment is needed for an accurate estimate.
